description: This file defines the ListShape class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a list data structure with methods for initializing and retrieving list members.

classes.name: ListShape
classes.description: Represents a list shape used in AWS API modeling, providing mechanisms to initialize and access list members.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ListShape object with the specified definition and shape map, setting its type as 'list'.

methods.name: getMember
methods.description: Returns the member shape of the list, creating it if it hasn't been initialized yet; throws exception if no member is specified.
